description.value: RedBeef Noodle Kitchen is a Taiwanese beef noodle restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, specializing in handcrafted soups built from slow-boiled beef bone broth simmered for over 12 hours with exotic Chinese spices. The menu spans more than two dozen noodle preparations alongside rice bowls, dumplings, and desserts, reflecting serious culinary craft rooted in a Taiwanese tradition. Multiple branch locations and an online ordering option make it a substantive dining stop for cyclists moving through the Main Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Taiwanese beef noodle restaurant with an 'Order Online' navigation item supporting takeout, and explicit vegetarian menu items (Signature Vegetarian Noodle Soup, Vegetarian Dry Noodles, Teriyaki Tofu Rice). OSM tag internet_access=no provides explicit negative evidence for Wi-Fi. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms was found in either the website content or OSM tags; the contact subpage rendered without visible address or phone details, so those fields cannot be cross-confirmed.
concerns: Contact subpage rendered with no visible phone number or address, so OSM phone and address could not be cross-confirmed against website.
Website references 'all our branch locations' but the locations subpage content was not captured; this OSM record may represent one of several outlets.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Taiwanese noodle restaurant on a key Vancouver cycling corridor with indoor seating, online ordering, and vegetarian options; provides a solid meal stop for touring cyclists.
